title: HadesMiMC Full-Data Attack Protection Bound
summary: Experiments motivate a sufficient round condition for HadesMiMC, but protection against the specified full-data attack under that condition remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For HadesMiMC with parameters $N,t,\alpha,R_F,R_P$, prove or refute the conjecture that the construction is protected against the full-data Gr?bner-basis attack strategy using plaintext-ciphertext pairs whenever $$R_F t+R_P\geq \left\lceil\frac{N}{2\log_2\!\left(\alpha^\alpha/(\alpha-1)^{\alpha-1}\right)}\right\rceil+\left\lceil\frac{t}{2}\right\rceil+1.$$ This proposed sufficient condition is motivated by practical tests with $\alpha=3$, in which the attack complexity was minimized at $M=1$ plaintext-ciphertext pair, and by analogous results in the decryption direction.

scope.domain: Algebraic cryptanalysis of the HadesMiMC block-cipher construction under a full-data attack strategy.
parameters: N, t, alpha, R_F, and R_P: construction parameters appearing in the conjectured condition
M: number of plaintext-ciphertext pairs in the motivating test
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove or refute whether the construction is protected against the full-data Gr?bner-basis attack strategy using plaintext-ciphertext pairs under the stated condition.

citations.label: On a Generalization of Substitution-Permutation Networks: The HADES Design Strategy

progress.summary: The source presents this as an explicit conjecture motivated by practical tests with alpha=3, where attack complexity was minimized at one plaintext-ciphertext pair, together with analogous results in the decryption direction.
